description: Render a PDF from Markdown, HTML, or a hosted template (invoice, certificate, report) using the PaperType API, and save it to disk. Returns the absolute file path, page count and remaining quota; the PDF bytes are never returned inline. Provide exactly one source: `markdown`, `html`, or `template` + `data`. Each call uses one document of the account's monthly quota.

author.description: Author shown on the cover page and in PDF metadata.

cover.description: Add a cover page with title, author and date (markdown/html). Default false.

css.description: Extra CSS appended after the theme (markdown/html). May include @page rules, e.g. '@page { margin: 2cm }'.

data.description: JSON object of fields for the chosen template (required when template is set). Shape per template is shown by list_templates.

date.description: Date text shown on the cover page, e.g. '2026-10-18' or 'October 2026'.

filename.description: Suggested file name (e.g. 'invoice-014.pdf'). Used for the saved file's name when output_path is not given.

footer.description: Footer text printed bottom-left on every page (e.g. a confidentiality note).

header.description: Running header text printed top-right on every page.

html.description: HTML document or fragment to render. A theme wraps it in page styles unless theme is 'none'. Provide exactly one of markdown, html, or template+data.

markdown.description: Markdown source for the document (GitHub-flavoured: headings, lists, tables, fenced code, footnotes, admonitions). Provide exactly one of markdown, html, or template+data.

output_path.description: Where to save the PDF. Omit to get a unique file named after the title under the server's output directory (PAPERTYPE_OUTPUT_DIR, default <tmp>/papertype). An existing directory (or a path ending in '/') saves a uniquely named file inside it. Any other path is used as the exact file name ('.pdf' appended if missing; an existing file is overwritten). Relative paths resolve against the output directory.

page_numbers.description: Print page numbers in the footer. Default true.

page_size.description: Paper size. Default A4. Use 'Letter' for US documents.

template.description: Name of a hosted template to fill with `data` instead of writing markdown/html: 'invoice', 'certificate' or 'report'. Call list_templates to see each template's fields and sample data.

theme.description: Page style for markdown/html input. 'clean' (default, general documents), 'report' (formal, good with cover+toc), 'minimal' (plain), 'letter' (correspondence), 'none' (HTML only: no theme, just your own CSS). Ignored for templates.

title.description: Document title: used for the PDF metadata, the cover page, and the default output filename.

toc.description: Add a table of contents built from headings. Markdown input only. Default false.

name: render_pdf
title: Render a PDF with PaperType
